items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I would come down and sit in the pit with Basie with my horn, and jam with him.

ctx.x: Oh, it was the Southern Serenaders there.
Yeah, and they finally became the Blue Devils under the tutelage of Walter Paige, which later became Count Basie. See?

Now, in Kansas City they had -- well, of this -- as I told you, we were working in Dallas, Missouri, and we used to come into Kansas City on weekends, and whatnot, and get our haircuts, and whatnot, and try to meet the musicians. So finally, one night we got in a dice game with the boss, at Dallas, Missouri, and --
